# **PoC: Real-Time Neural Receiver (NRX)**

# **Prototype**

  * # Quectel RM520N-GL 5G Modem

  * # Jetson AGX Orin DevKit

  * # Over-the-cable experiment with 24 PRBs @ 3.6GHz

  * # NRX trained via 3GPP UMi channel model (Sionna PHY)

  * # NRX injected in OAI PUSCH (full slot per inference)




# **Results**

  * # Real-time inference in the AI-RAN is possible!

  * # Dynamic shapes are a challenge (#PRBs)
